# NonlinearTransientDynamics

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The transient, non-equilibrium responses of a dynamical system used as computational states before settling into attractors. Exploits rich, high-dimensional transient behavior in physical substrates for efficient neuromorphic computation in iNEST.
